measured_on.mount_as: normal user, image file (not a block device)

classes.effective: accepted and the effect was observed
classes.ignored: accepted (exit 0, mount appears) with no observable effect
classes.rejected: ntfs-3g or libfuse refuses it: non-zero exit status and a message
classes.silent: accepted but the stated behaviour is not delivered; the daemon must check the precondition itself
classes.by-source: accepted; the effect is known from the NTFS-3G source but was not observed in the matrix

always.note: without it (or with any other value) ntfs-3g exits 0, no mount appears, SIGTERM is ignored; SIGKILL needed
